resources.string: Get the reading from the monitor via Bluetooth
Switch the monitor on and press its Bluetooth button, or take a reading. Keep the phone close.
The search is over. Pick the monitor from the list.
Your monitor was not found. Pick another one or search again.
If the phone offers to pair the devices, agree.
Press the button on the monitor
The monitor will send its last reading. I will wait up to a minute and a half.
This phone cannot connect to Bluetooth LE devices. Enter the numbers by hand, from a photo or by voice.
Turn Bluetooth on to receive a reading from the monitor.
The app looks for the monitor nearby and connects to it. Your location is not used, nothing is sent anywhere.
Before Android 12 the system hides nearby Bluetooth devices from apps without location access. The app does not learn or store where you are.
The system will not ask again — allow it in the app settings.
Before Android 12 the system finds Bluetooth devices only while location is on. The app does not use your location.
Wait half a minute and try again.
Check that the monitor is on and close, and press its Bluetooth button. It must support the standard Bluetooth blood pressure profile.
The device does not offer the standard Bluetooth blood pressure service, so the app cannot read it. Enter the numbers by hand, from a photo or by voice.
The monitor did not connect or disconnected. Move the phone closer and try again.
The monitor sent nothing in a minute and a half. Take a reading or press the Bluetooth button on it, then try again.
